verdict.rationale: The only evidence is a single probe. Its TLS verification failed at https://aima.gov.pt/robots.txt, and 'nothing on the host was fetched', so no robots.txt is currently retrievable for an agent to read before fetching. The probe mentions that a prior-day dossier saw an open robots.txt, but that is a secondhand reference rather than independent evidence, and there is only one evidence tier, so 'disputed' is not available; the axis applies, so the verdict is 'none', not 'na'.

support.subject: As an AI-native founder, the service publishes a real robots.txt, so an agent can know what it may read before fetching anything
